mapper.sql: id, request_uri, method, status, cost_ms, trace_id, username, client_ip, reason, exception_msg, alerted, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_slow_request (request_uri, method, status, cost_ms, trace_id, username, client_ip, reason, exception_msg, alerted, create_time) VALUES (#{requestUri}, #{method}, #{status}, #{costMs}, #{traceId}, #{username}, #{clientIp}, #{reason}, #{exceptionMsg}, COALESCE(#{alerted}, '0'), COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_slow_request SET alerted = '1' WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_slow_request WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_slow_request WHERE alerted = '0'
